_about: Hand-curated segments where the boxer is working TOWARD the camera, i.e. the camera stands where the opponent would be. Selection criterion is gaze/punch direction, NOT shoulder-line squareness -- selecting on squareness would produce a set with no bladed boxers in it. Shared across research topics, not bladedness-specific.
_schema: stem -> [ {label, round, start_sec, end_sec} ]. DO NOT re-derive the span semantics -- ml/frontal_spans.py is the one reader, and its docstring is the spec (null starts/ends, the `round` binding, the _pts.npy indexing rule). `exclude_from_reel` keeps a span for analysis but out of review reels; it does NOT narrow the span used for analysis. `clip_window: [a, b]` is INERT -- nothing reads it (see the one entry that carries it). Stems match ml/video_wh.json exactly (beware double spaces in titles).
_sibling: ml/side_segments.json is the mirror set (camera side-on, sagittal plane) for fore-aft measurements. Two stems appear in both, at disjoint times -- those videos change camera angle partway through. Match on (stem, span), never stem alone.
